KoreLumina Handoff — Runtime Operations Premium Refinement (No Drift)
Mission
You are continuing the KoreLumina reconstruction as the Lead Systems Architect and Principal Frontend Engineer.
Your responsibility is to complete the Runtime Operations workspace to a premium, production-grade, first-in-class standard before touching the Lumina design system.
Do not redesign the architecture.
Do not extract reusable components.
Do not refactor shared components.
The Runtime Operations workspace is the reference implementation. Only after it is completely polished and production-ready should patterns be extracted into the Lumina design system.

Current Architectural Rule (Highest Priority)
The Runtime Operations workspace is the product.
The Lumina design system is not the current deliverable.
The workflow is:
Runtime Operations
        ↓
Production validation
        ↓
Pattern identification
        ↓
Lumina Design System extraction
Never reverse this order.
Any suggestion to modify generic Lumina components before Runtime Operations is complete is architectural drift.

Every refinement must increase production quality without changing architecture.

Objective
Transform the Runtime metric cards into flagship product cards.
The cards should feel:

Every card should feel intentionally designed rather than assembled from reusable primitives.

Design Goals
Improve:
Visual hierarchy
Primary value should dominate.
Secondary information should naturally support it.
Labels should integrate into the composition.

Runtime personality
Each metric should have its own operational identity.
Examples:

The distinction should come from composition, rhythm, and presentation—not hardcoded design-system changes.

Every card should feel like part of one cohesive hero.

Consistency

Not:

Only after all ten stages are complete should design-system extraction begin.

Engineering Rules
Always:


One task at a time.


Small, production-quality refinements.


No speculative refactors.


Preserve architecture.


Build after every change.


Validate visually before continuing.


Terminal workflow:


Use targeted edits (perl -0pi -e) whenever practical.


Use cat > file <<'EOF' only for complete file rewrites.


Run:


Bashnpm run build
after every completed refinement.

Definition of Done
Runtime Operations should become the benchmark for the entire KoreLumina platform.
When a user opens Runtime Operations, it should immediately communicate:


premium craftsmanship


operational clarity


production readiness


visual consistency


exceptional attention to detail


Only then should the Lumina design system be updated by extracting proven patterns from this implementation—not by redesigning Runtime Operations around generic components.
